tool: built-in image_gen; model, seed and generation settings not exposed
notes: Each draft is frozen, not regenerated during export. The requested 1536 canvas was returned as 1254; actual 209px cells are recorded explicitly.
All poses use the same per-identity scale; registration adjusts placement, never frame-by-frame body size. Clip timings remain the existing v2 contract.
Alpha threshold removes the draft's low-alpha coloured fringe. Shared 32-colour, non-dithered palette creates hard pixel edges.
No painted FX in body poses. FX is a separate empty editable layer; the existing runtime continues to own combat FX.
Source support sheets are identity/palette references. New full-body poses are AI-assisted derivatives, not original game rips or a full sheet provided by Megadoomer.
